## What is changing

Page(s) and section(s).

## Source

Where the copy or images come from, e.g. Daw Mi's email, a partner's website, or a photo shoot.

## Approval and permission

- [ ] Wording approved by Daw Mi
- [ ] Permission to use third-party images or text (who gave it, and when)
- [ ] Credit or link required by the source, if any

## Assets

- [ ] Images converted to WebP, EXIF metadata stripped
- [ ] Meaningful alt text written
- [ ] Original, full-resolution files requested where needed

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `[To confirm]` placeholders left in the changed sections
